title: [Day 02] Session format and event types
text:
@cursor Part 1 of 5 for issue #2: Base types.

Read AGENTS.md (sections Parts, QA and bug fixes, Commits), .cursor/rules (including 90-lessons.mdc) and docs/ARCHITECTURE.md first. Read the whole issue, then do ONLY Part 1.

Work test-first: first a test commit `test(shared): add base event and DOM node types (#2)` with tests and stubs, then the implementation commit.

Prompt: Create the base event shape, the `EventType` union and the serialized DOM node types in `packages/shared/src/types/`.

Requirements:
- `BaseEvent<T, D>` with `type`, `seq`, `timestamp`, `data` exactly as in the issue
- Node types: Document, Doctype, Element, Text, Comment, CDATA, each with `id: number`
- Everything exported from `src/index.ts` with TSDoc

Checks you must run before pushing:
- `pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test` pass
- A type test file `types.test-d.ts` or `types.test.ts` with `expectTypeOf` exists

Implementation commit message: `feat(shared): add base event and DOM node types (#2)`

Author every commit as the owner and credit yourself: `git -c user.name="Sergei Kamalian" -c user.email="106472907+SergeiKamalian@users.noreply.github.com" commit --trailer "Co-authored-by: Cursor Agent <cursoragent@cursor.com>" ...`

Day 01 (PR #8) is finished but not merged yet. Create branch `day-02/session-format` from `day-01/monorepo-setup`, push, and open a DRAFT PR with base `day-01/monorepo-setup`, titled "[Day 02] Session format and event types", with "Closes #2" and the PR template filled.
